# Luma

Luma is a self-hosted AI business operating system in the PcButNoBTC/Jarvis repository.

## Core loop

Discover → Research → Qualify → Sell → Configure → Build → QA → Launch/Handoff → Measure → Learn.

## Primary capabilities

- prospect ingestion and deduplication
- evidence-first website research
- multi-service opportunity qualification
- client-trust sales workflows
- human-gated outreach
- proposal and project lifecycle
- service-specific project configuration
- delivery artifacts and QA
- bounded static deployment
- client portal
- billing and revenue analytics
- recurring revenue
- agent policies, scopes, budgets and evaluations
- governed provider execution
- OAuth token refresh
- secret references and Infisical integration
- distributed PostgreSQL-backed rate limiting
- durable workflows and schedules
- client outcome metrics
- outcome-to-blueprint optimization with human approval
- regional growth playbooks

## Services

AI Website; AI Receptionist; Lead Capture System; Appointment Automation; Review Automation; Video Walkthrough; Custom Automation.

## Runtime providers

Google Calendar, Microsoft Outlook, Calendly, HubSpot, SMTP and Twilio have runtime adapter paths. Stripe, hosting, forms and analytics have foundations/registry entries where applicable and are not universally production-complete.

## Governance

Consequential actions follow identity → rate limit → scope → risk → approval → secret retrieval → provider adapter → audit → receipt → outcome.

## Secret model

PostgreSQL stores secret references. Provider credentials belong in the configured secret backend. A self-hosted Infisical deployment bundle is provided under infrastructure/infisical/.

## Important limitations

Luma does not fabricate credentials, DNS ownership, provider accounts or external permissions. Universal autonomous provisioning is not claimed. Live provider credentials and real-account testing are required before production declarations.
